Definition
Source: topping:page-0106, topping:page-0107 1. ch9:2.1\group curvature-pinching The Einstein tensor is the symmetric $(0,2)$-tensor \[ E=-\Ric +\frac{R}{2}g. \] In dimension three, with sectional curvatures $\lambda _1,\lambda _2,\lambda _3$ on an orthonormal basis of curvature 2-planes, the corresponding orthonormal basis diagonalises $E$, whose eigenvalues are $\lambda _1,\lambda _2,\lambda _3$.
